scientific_integrity: Arbitrary-dimensional argument uses strict logarithmic concavity and a positive exact pendant-edge multiplier certificate. Finite code tests corroborate rather than certify the infinite statement. Historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Excludes non-bipartite cores, core vertices without private leaves, and arbitrary affine metrics; contact and clearance are stated for genuine signed edge facets. An earlier equivalent graph-entropy formulation is possible.
scope: Every finite bipartite core H; at least one pendant leaf per core vertex; standard orthonormal Euclidean coordinates; unique maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid of the enriched chain polytope.
title: Core-edge invisibility for the John ellipsoid of leaf-corona enriched chain polytopes
